articles.title: Jensen Huang confiesa que va a terapia y se resiste a nombrar un sucesor
articles.text:
Jensen Huang, consejero delegado de Nvidia, pidió disculpas públicas a los empleados de la compañía por el escándalo personal que derivó en su salida y posterior reincorporación al cargo en menos de dos semanas. “Cometí errores terribles”, reconoció el directivo el martes 24 de noviembre durante una reunión transmitida en vivo para toda la empresa y revisada por The New York Times. “Fui infiel a Lori, y lastimé a mis hijos y, por supuesto, los lastimé a todos ustedes”.
La disculpa llegó un día después de que Huang regresara como director ejecutivo de la empresa que fundó hace tres décadas, y menos de dos semanas después de haber sido apartado del cargo. Según una fuente consultada por CNN, el encuentro con el personal se extendió durante una hora.
Huang reconoce la terapia diaria y defiende el código de conducta
Huang relató que se encuentra en terapia más de una hora cada día. Calificó el encuentro con el personal como una de las reuniones más difíciles de su carrera, aunque señaló que “la reunión más difícil que he tenido fue con mi esposa”, según una fuente citada por CNN.
El directivo explicó que renunció porque violó el código de conducta de la empresa, pero remarcó que su regreso no significa que esté “por encima” de esas normas. Según la misma fuente, Huang indicó que infringir el código de conducta no implica de manera automática el despido, y que corresponde a la gerencia decidir en cada caso, tal como hizo la junta con su situación.
El ejecutivo también se disculpó con su esposa y sus hijos y dijo sentirse agradecido por tener una segunda oportunidad. Sus dos hijos, Madison y Spencer Huang, ocupan cargos ejecutivos en Nvidia, al igual que su yerno, Nico Caprez.
El empresario niega que Trump haya presionado a la junta
Pese a reconocer sus errores personales, Huang rechazó la versión de que fuera un “tech bro” que se consideraba “por encima de la ley”. El ejecutivo calificó de “completamente falso” que el presidente estadounidense, Donald Trump, hubiera presionado a la junta de Nvidia para reincorporarlo. Según su versión, la junta cambió de postura porque “evaluó toda la situación” y “reunió los hechos”. Huang añadió que Trump garantizó a los directivos que él no representaba una amenaza para la seguridad nacional.
Esta explicación contrasta con declaraciones del propio Trump, quien en una extensa entrevista con CNBC el lunes se atribuyó el mérito del regreso de Huang y afirmó haber apelado de manera directa a la junta en su favor.
De acuerdo con Semafor, el mandatario se conectó por teléfono a la reunión de directorio de Nvidia del domingo para abogar por la reincorporación del ejecutivo. La propia junta de la compañía declaró públicamente el lunes que tomó la decisión con “aporte de altos niveles del Gobierno de Estados Unidos”.
Entretanto, el Gobierno estadounidense investiga si Megaspeed desvió semiconductores de Nvidia hacia China en violación de los controles de exportación. Funcionarios estadounidenses también plantearon dudas sobre el presunto rol de Alice Huang, quien tuvo un presunto romance con el CEO de Nvidia, como activo de inteligencia chino.
Huang se resiste a nombrar un sucesor
Durante la reunión, Huang también defendió la estructura de gestión horizontal de Nvidia, en la que mantiene decenas de reportes directos sin un sucesor claramente definido. Explicó que ese esquema refleja la diversidad del negocio de la empresa y otorga a todos “igual voz” frente a él.
Durante su ausencia, la directora financiera Colette Kress se desempeñó como consejera delegada interina, mientras la junta evaluaba candidatos internos y externos para el cargo. El ejecutivo no respondió preguntas en la reunión, aunque en un momento hizo una pausa para pedir a los presentes retroalimentación sobre lo que explicaba.

articles.title: Le mini PC NiPoGi AM06 Pro avec Ryzen 5, 16+512 Go et triple affichage 4K perd 126 € pour le Black Friday
articles.text:
Le NiPoGi AM06 Pro est un mini PC qui vient remplacer une tour bureautique que vous retrouvez sur Amazon pendant le Black Friday à 407,55 euros au lieu de 533,35 euros.
Le NiPoGi AM06 Pro est un mini PC orienté bureautique légèrement costaude. Son avantage, c'est bien sûr ses dimensions, car il prend la forme d'un petit boîtier que vous pouvez emmener partout, même si son utilisation est principalement sédentaire. C'est un ordinateur qui s'adresse principalement aux étudiants, aux télétravailleurs et aux utilisateurs qui recherchent une machine peu encombrante pour la bureautique, la navigation web et le multimédia, plutôt qu'un PC pour les jeux exigeants. Vous pouvez sauter le pas sur Amazon puisqu'il perd 125,80 euros pour le Black Friday.
Voici le NiPoGi AM06 Pro à 407,55 € au lieu de 533,35 € sur Amazon
Pourquoi choisir le NiPoGi AM06 Pro ?
- Pour son Ryzen 5 7430U basé sur l'architecture Zen 3, une configuration adaptée à la bureautique, au multitâche et aux applications courantes.
- Sa configuration évolutive avec ses 16 Go qui peuvent devenir 64 Go et le SSD M.2 de 512 Go qui peu être remplacé par un jusqu'à 2 To.
- Pour sa connectique complète avec deux ports Ethernet, du WiFi 6, du Bluetooth 5.2, 4 ports USB-A, un port USB-C, deux ports LAN, un HDMI et un DP.
Un mini PC polyvalent pour travailler sur plusieurs écrans
Avec son processeur à six cœurs et ses 16 Go de RAM, le NiPoGi AM06 Pro a les ressources nécessaires pour enchaîner les tâches bureautiques, les visioconférences, la navigation avec plusieurs onglets et la lecture de vidéos. Sa compatibilité avec trois écrans 4K peut aussi intéresser les personnes qui veulent étendre leur espace de travail. Et ses deux ports Ethernet Gigabit offrent des possibilités supplémentaires pour une installation réseau, pour faire du NiPoGi AM06 un serveur domestique. Le constructeur annonce la prise en charge du Wake on LAN, du démarrage programmé et de l'allumage automatique, des fonctions pratiques pour certains usages pros ou multimédias.
Que vaut le NiPoGi AM06 Pro face aux autres mini PC ?
Malgré son nom de Ryzen 7000, le Ryzen 5 7430U repose sur l'architecture Zen 3 et non sur une génération récente de cœurs, et sa puce graphique Radeon intégrée reste limitée pour les jeux 3D exigeants et les travaux de création lourds. À ce prix, il faut donc le considérer comme un mini PC bureautique bien équipé plutôt que comme une alternative à une tour performante ou à des modèles plus récents de Beelink ou Minisforum.
✅ Les points forts
- Son processeur polyvalent
- Les 16 Go de mémoire DDR4 extensibles jusqu'à 64 Go
- L'évolution aussi possible sur le SSD M.2
- La prise en charge de trois écrans 4K
- Le double port Ethernet Gigabit
- Le support VESA
- Windows 11 Pro préinstallé
❌ Les limites
- Le processeur n'est pas de dernière génération
- La partie graphique peu adaptée à la 3D exigeante
- Le SSD de 512 Go se remplit rapidement
- La RAM DDR4 moins vive que la DDR5
S'il vous intéresse, le NiPoGi AM06 Pro est en promo à 407,55 € au lieu de 533,35 € jusqu'au 30/11/2026
Le NiPoGi AM06 Pro est une solution intéressante si vous cherchez un ordinateur compact à installer sur votre bureau, dans le salon ou derrière n'importe quel moniteur. Sa configuration, cohérente avec ses ambitions, en fait un appareil de choix pour la bureautique, les études, le télétravail et le multimédia.
Il faut toutefois garder les pieds sur terre concernant ses performances. La Radeon intégrée ne fera pas de miracles dans les jeux récents, et le Ryzen 5 7430U n'est plus de toute première jeunesse. Malgré tout, si vous manquez de place et que vous n'avez pas d'ambitions démesurées quant à ses performances, ça reste un produit intéressant.

articles.title: Google Researcher Shows How a Single Bit Change in .NET Files Bypassed Windows Code Integrity
articles.text:
A quirk in how the .NET Framework loads a program file let a local attacker run untrusted code past two separate protections on Windows built to block it, Google Project Zero researcher James Forshaw showed in a write-up published yesterday.
The same loading behavior bypassed Oracle VirtualBox's process hardening on Windows hosts, tracked as CVE-2026-87268, and Windows code integrity, tracked as CVE-2026-108398.
Oracle fixed the VirtualBox flaw in September, and Microsoft fixed the Windows one on October 13, both before the write-up appeared.
VirtualBox on Windows monitors the system calls that load program files into its virtual machine processes, so a less-trusted user on the same computer cannot push code into them. Forshaw got past that watch through the .NET Framework.
The framework can run a .NET program file from a plain copy in memory when the normal way of loading it, as an executable image, fails. Version 4 of the framework takes that fallback on one specific error, and the memory copy skips the image checks a loaded program would face.
The VirtualBox check returned that error for any .NET file compiled as AnyCPU, a form meant to run on any processor, so an unchanged file loaded through the path the hardening never inspects.
To get the file loaded while a virtual machine was started, he registered a COM object in the current user's settings that a protected VirtualBox process would pull in, a method known as COM hijacking. He set out the mechanism in his technical analysis.
Oracle rates the flaw, CVE-2026-87268, as a local problem that needs low privileges and no user interaction, scores it 7.8, and lists VirtualBox 7.2.16 on Windows hosts as affected. Its security advisory says a successful attack can result in the "takeover of Oracle VM VirtualBox."
The code runs inside the protected VirtualBox process. It is not a break out of a guest virtual machine onto the host, and the attacker begins as an ordinary user on that host.
The same idea worked against Windows' own code-integrity checks, which decide what user-mode code is allowed to run. There is no VirtualBox hook here, only the system call that maps a file as an image.
The researcher found that clearing a single bit in a .NET file's header, the IMAGE_FILE_EXECUTABLE_IMAGE flag, made that call reject the file while .NET still loaded and ran it.
"This single bit change is all you need to load an untrusted .NET assembly," he wrote. He tried it on Windows 11 S Mode, which enables User Mode Code Integrity (UMCI), the policy that limits which user-mode programs can run. A logic error in .NET's own policy check let the file load even with UMCI enforced.
The flaw, CVE-2026-108398, works through the .NET Framework version 4 loading path and needs a program willing to load the assembly. It is not a way to seize any Windows machine over the internet.
Microsoft rates it a local, low-privilege security-feature bypass, scores it 8.8, and fixed it on October 13. The company lists it as publicly disclosed but not used in attacks.
The same file reached a more sensitive target as well. Protected Process Light, or PPL, is a kind of Windows process that ordinary programs, even ones with administrator rights, are not meant to enter. By hijacking a COM object that WerSecureFault.exe loads, he ran his test code inside a PPL process at the highest protection level without administrator rights.
The older Protected Process type resisted the technique because the .NET runtime files lack the page hashes it requires. The October fix corrects the policy check for UMCI but does not change loading for protected processes, so that PPL route should still work, according to the researcher. It carries no separate CVE.
What to patch
On Windows hosts, update VirtualBox to a build that carries the September fixes. The affected versions are 7.2.16 and 7.2.18, and 7.2.18 shipped on September 15 with that set. An upstream code fix is not the same as a released binary, so check the running version rather than assume an older build already has it.
.NET systems need the October 13 update that matches the exact Windows and .NET Framework version in use, not one shared package. The update release notes list the right KB for each. On Windows 11 version 26H2, for example, it is KB5127694.
| Flaw | Affected | Fixed in | 
|---|---|---|
| CVE-2026-87268 (VirtualBox) | VirtualBox 7.2.16, Windows hosts | Oracle's September update, build 7.2.18 | 
| CVE-2026-108398 (.NET Framework) | .NET Framework 4 on Windows, UMCI case tested on Windows 11 S Mode | October 13 update, per-version KB | 
Forshaw first presented the Windows code-integrity bypass at the 44Con conference in September, having judged it fell outside Microsoft's rules for what gets fixed. After .NET developers told him the behavior he had counted on was accidental, he reported it in late September. The fix arrived in October's Patch Tuesday, less than a month later.

articles.text:
RTX 5090-equipped Asus ROG Strix SCAR 16 laptop is $350 off — snag a great deal on a ridiculously powerful 2025-model 16-inch gaming laptop with 32GB of RAM and Core Ultra 9 275HX processor for only $4,149
One of the least expensive RTX 5090-equipped laptops we could find in stock
After looking around for laptop deals, we finally found one that’s worth sharing. Newegg has the Asus ROG Strix SCAR 16 (G635LX-XS97) on sale; it's one of the least expensive RTX 5090-equipped gaming laptops we’ve seen so far for Black Friday week. Hardware-wise, the SCAR 16 comes with a 8p/16e (24 threads) Intel Core Ultra 9 275HX processor with peak boost speeds up to 5.4 GHz, along with 13 TOPS from the NPU. It also comes with 32GB (2x16GB) of DDR5-5600 RAM. While this isn’t the fastest RAM available, it’s

Get a great deal on this flagship-class ROG Strix Scar 16 gaming laptop from Amazon. You'll be able to play most games at high frame rates or even run your own local AI.

Otherwise, the clock speed is limited to 1,597MHz. And of course, it comes with the full complement of 24GB GDDR7, easily running today's (and tomorrow’s!) games at WQXGA 2560x1600 (16:10 aspect ratio). It’s also ideal for running large AI models, too. The 240Hz Mini-LED display covers 100% of the DCI-P3 color gamut and has a 3ms response time. So it’s good for productivity and gaming purposes.

articles.title: CD Projekt RED Teams Up With Sony for The Witcher 4 Marketing Campaign
articles.text:
Wednesday, November 25th 2026
CD Projekt RED Teams Up With Sony for The Witcher 4 Marketing Campaign
CD Projekt RED will work with Sony Interactive Entertainment on the marketing for The Witcher 4. That was revealed during the company's Q3 2026 earnings webcast on November 24. CDPR signed new partnership agreements with Sony on the same day, and apparently those agreements include more than just marketing. CDPR's games will launch on PlayStation and will also be included in the PlayStation Plus subscription service. It is not yet clear which games that deal will include, or what the company means by "marketing," but we can certainly expect collaboration between the two parties on future projects, including The Witcher 4. Here's what CDPR CFO Piotr Nielubowicz said on the webcast:
Piotr Nielubowicz, CFO CD Projekt RedJust today, we signed new partnership agreements with Sony Interactive Entertainment covering the presence of our games on PlayStation and in PlayStation Plus subscriptions, as well as our collaboration during the upcoming Witcher 4 marketing campaign.
He added that the deal "will support our business and financial outlook in this and future years." There were no numbers shared, but judging by Piotr's words, it does sound quite lucrative for CDPR. We should remember that the company has some prior history with Sony's PlayStation Plus service. The base edition of Cyberpunk 2077 joined the PlayStation Plus Extra and Premium catalog in July 2025, which helped CDPR's financials quite a bit at that time. The Witcher 4 is currently targeting a 2028 release window on PC, PS5, and Xbox Series X|S. It was also recently voted the Most Wanted Game at the Golden Joystick Awards 2026.

articles.title: Pour le Black Friday 2026, l'aspirateur balai Dyson V15 Detect Absolute passe à 469,00 €
articles.text:
Black Friday 2026 : L'aspirateur balai Dyson V15 Detect Absolute à 469,00 € (-11%)
À l'occasion du Black Friday, le Dyson V15 Detect Absolute passe à 469,00 € chez Fnac.com et Darty.com, soit une baisse d'environ 11 % et 56,67 € d'économie. Efficace pour nettoyer tous les sols grâce à son aspiration solide et sa filtration irréprochable, cet aspirateur balai affiche une note actuelle de 4,5/5 dans nos tests.
Avec le V15 Detect Absolute, Dyson propose un aspirateur balai au format stick équipé d'un laser pour éclairer les poussières et d'un capteur pour adapter la puissance d'aspiration. L'appareil est conçu pour nettoyer tous les types de sols grâce à ses nombreuses brosses motorisées et son système de filtration complet. Ce modèle avait convaincu notre laboratoire lors de son passage sur les bancs de test.
À l'occasion du Black Friday, le Dyson V15 Detect Absolute descend à 469,00 € chez Fnac.com et Darty.com, soit environ 11 % de moins que le prix moyen constaté ces 30 derniers jours (525,67 €). Cette baisse de prix permet d'économiser 56,67 €.
Une efficacité d'aspiration totale sur les sols durs et les tapis
Cet aspirateur balai assure un nettoyage en profondeur sans nécessiter plusieurs passages. Sur sol dur en mode normal, les mesures de notre test complet relèvent 100 % de matières aspirées en seulement 30 secondes, ce qui évite de repasser au même endroit. Sa filtration multicyclonique combinée à un filtre HEPA retient l'intégralité des microparticules : le test d'encrassement du filtre affiche 0 g, garantissant un flux d'air sain dans la pièce.
Dyson V15 Detect Absolute
Points forts
- Performances d'aspiration.
- Filtration parfaite.
- Entretien simplissime.
- Indications d'autonomie précises.
Points faibles
- Appareil un peu lourd à la longue.
- Laser un peu gadget.
- S'essouffle bien vite en mode Boost.

articles.title: Dónde conviene jugar GTA 6: las diferencias clave entre PS5 y Xbox
articles.text:
El lanzamiento global de la nueva entrega de Rockstar reabrió una pregunta habitual entre los jugadores: en qué consola conviene experimentar el título. Un análisis del canal ElAnalistaDeBits comparó el comportamiento de PS5, PS5 Pro, Xbox Series X y Xbox Series S en aspectos como resolución, reflejos, sombras con ray-tracing, calidad del agua, distancia de dibujado, nivel de detalle y cuadros por segundo.
Las conclusiones muestran que, aunque el juego mantiene una base técnica similar en todas las plataformas, existen diferencias que pueden inclinar la balanza según el tipo de experiencia que busque cada usuario.
En las cuatro versiones, GTA 6 apunta a un objetivo de 30 fps y no incorpora un modo rendimiento, una decisión que iguala el punto de partida entre consolas pero no el resultado final.
Según el análisis, el título se ve como “un portento visual” en todos los sistemas, aunque la estabilidad de esos cuadros por segundo varía de una plataforma a otra.
Cuántos fps tiene GTA 6 en cada consola
La ausencia de un modo rendimiento implica que ninguna de las cuatro ediciones prioriza la fluidez por sobre la calidad gráfica. GTA 6 funciona a 30 fps tanto en PS5 como en PS5 Pro, Xbox Series X y Xbox Series S, sin una alternativa que sacrifique definición visual a cambio de mayor velocidad.
La diferencia entre plataformas no está en el número objetivo de cuadros, sino en qué tan constante se mantiene ese número durante el juego. Según el análisis de ElAnalistaDeBits, PS5 Pro ofrece el rendimiento más estable de toda la generación, mientras que Xbox Series X exhibe una estabilidad ligeramente superior a la de la PS5 estándar.
El panorama cambia en el extremo más limitado del catálogo de consolas. Xbox Series S presenta más caídas para sostener los 30 fps, lo que la convierte en la opción menos recomendable entre las cuatro analizadas a la hora de buscar una experiencia pareja.
Resolución y tecnologías de reescalado en cada versión
Más allá de la tasa de cuadros, la resolución y las tecnologías de reconstrucción de imagen marcan otra de las diferencias entre ediciones. PS5 y Xbox Series X comparten el mismo esquema: parten de una resolución base de 1440p y utilizan el sistema de reescalado TAA para alcanzar los 2160p, equivalentes a 4K, con configuraciones gráficas similares entre sí.
PS5 Pro también arranca desde 1440p, pero emplea una tecnología distinta, PSSR, para reconstruir la imagen hasta los 2160p. Esa diferencia técnica se traduce, según el análisis, en una mayor nitidez respecto del resto de las consolas.
La versión de PS5 Pro no se limita a una resolución más definida. También incorpora mayor nivel de detalle general en iluminación global, en las sombras generadas por ray-tracing y en los reflejos, un salto que resulta especialmente visible en la representación del agua dentro del juego.
Xbox Series S, en cambio, trabaja con parámetros más bajos desde el inicio. Su resolución base es de 720p, aunque se convierte en el primer juego de Xbox en utilizar la tecnología de reescalado FSR 4 para llevar la imagen hasta los 1080p.
Qué sacrificios tiene la versión de Xbox Series S
Sostener el mundo abierto de Leonida y Vice City en una consola con menor potencia exigió ajustes puntuales en esta edición. Xbox Series S aplica recortes en iluminación, en sombras, en reflejos y en el nivel de detalle general respecto de las otras tres versiones analizadas.
A esos ajustes gráficos se suma una reducción en la densidad del entorno. La versión para Xbox Series S disminuye la cantidad de tráfico vehicular y de personajes no jugables (NPC) en determinadas zonas del mapa, una medida orientada a mantener el funcionamiento del juego dentro de los límites de hardware de la consola.
El resultado es una edición que prioriza la jugabilidad sobre la fidelidad visual, en línea con el perfil históricamente más limitado de Xbox Series S frente al resto de las consolas de la generación.

articles.title: 2027 SOC Budget Reset: 5 Priorities to Cut Costs and Reduce Cyber Risk
articles.text:
What if your biggest SOC budget problem isn't how much you spend, but how much analyst time you lose?
According to ANY.RUN's estimates, SOC teams could recover 450 analyst hours per 1,000 investigated alerts through faster threat analysis and IOC research. That's a significant opportunity as manual investigations, repeated checks, and unnecessary escalations continue to drain resources.
As 2027 approaches, here are five priorities to reduce SOC costs, recover capacity, and strengthen protection against costly cyberattacks.
Why 2027 SOC Budget Planning Is Getting More Challenging
Cybersecurity spending is facing conflicting pressures. According to IANS and Artico Search, 55% of CISOs reported flat or declining budgets in 2026. Meanwhile, PwC's 2027 Global Digital Trust Insights found that 84% of surveyed security and finance leaders expect cybersecurity budgets to increase.
For SOC leaders, this creates several challenges:
- Growing workloads: More alerts and complex threats demand additional investigation capacity.
- Rising operational costs: Manual processes, staffing needs, and expanding security infrastructure put pressure on budgets.
- Pressure to prove ROI: Every investment must demonstrate measurable improvements in security and operational efficiency.
- Increasing cyber risks: Cost reductions cannot come at the expense of detection coverage or response capabilities.
1. Prioritize AI That Delivers Measurable SOC Value
AI is becoming a major cybersecurity investment priority, but adding AI capabilities won't automatically improve SOC efficiency. For 2027, the focus should be on reducing investigation costs, improving analyst productivity, and avoiding unnecessary escalations.
For example, ANY.RUN's Interactive Sandbox combines automated threat analysis with AI-powered reporting to help teams achieve these goals:
- Cut manual investigation time: Automated Interactivity follows redirects, extracts QR code links, and handles supported CAPTCHAs, exposing malicious activity that would otherwise require additional analyst effort.
| ANY.RUN’s Interactive Sandbox automatically solves CAPTCHA, revealing full attack chain | 
- Reduce investigation and escalation costs: AI-powered Tier 1 reports provide clear summaries of malicious behavior and recommended next steps. This helps analysts make faster decisions and reduces the need for repeated investigations and unnecessary Tier 2 involvement.
| AI-powered Tier 1 report with attack summary and recommendations for faster handoffs | 
These improvements have measurable business value. ANY.RUN reports up to 20% lower Tier 1 workload and 30% fewer Tier 1-to-Tier 2 escalations, helping SOCs handle growing workloads with less pressure to expand their teams.
The 2027 budget priority: Evaluate AI investments based on investigation time, workload reduction, and escalation rates, not the number of AI features included.
Make Your 2027 AI Budget Deliver Measurable Results
Reduce Tier 1 workload by up to 20% and control investigation costs.
2. Recover Analyst Capacity Before Expanding Your Team
As alert volumes grow, hiring additional analysts may seem like the obvious solution. But before expanding headcount, SOCs should calculate how much capacity they could recover by improving investigation efficiency.
ANY.RUN estimates that faster behavioral analysis through its Interactive Sandbox, combined with less manual threat research, can save 450 analyst hours per 1,000 investigated alerts.
Consider a SOC handling 4,000 alerts annually:
| Metric | Estimated Value | 
|---|---|
| Annual investigated alerts | 4,000 | 
| Potential hours saved per 1,000 alerts | 450 | 
| Annual analyst hours recovered | 1,800 | 
| Fully loaded analyst hourly cost | $60 | 
| Annual labor capacity value | $108,000 | 
Illustrative calculation based on ANY.RUN's estimate and an assumed hourly rate. Actual results depend on SOC workloads and investigation processes.
The $108,000 represents recovered analyst capacity, not guaranteed cash savings. However, these hours could help reduce overtime, limit outsourcing, or defer additional hiring.
The budget priority: Compare projected alert volumes, investigation workloads, and staffing requirements before approving additional headcount. Recovering existing capacity can help SOCs handle more threats without proportional increases in personnel costs.
3. Reduce IOC Research Costs with Connected Threat Context
Investigating a suspicious IOC often means searching multiple sources to uncover related infrastructure, previous attacks, and malicious activity. These repeated checks consume analyst time and increase investigation costs.
Used by 700,000+ security professionals across 16,000+ organizations, ANY.RUN helps SOC teams benefit from threat intelligence generated through shared malware and phishing investigations.
Its Interactive Sandbox provides Related Threat Context, connecting discovered IOCs to previously observed threats. Analysts can pivot directly into Threat Intelligence Lookup to explore related IPs, domains, files, and attack infrastructure.
| Related threat context displayed inside TI Lookup for deeper investigations | 
This connected approach helps teams identify broader attack patterns faster, avoid repeated research, and make better-informed investigation decisions.
The budget priority: Reduce time spent on manual IOC enrichment and threat correlation. Faster access to relevant intelligence means lower investigation overhead and more capacity to investigate critical threats.
4. Get More Detection Value from Your Existing Security Stack
Before investing in additional security products, organizations should consider how effectively their existing systems use threat intelligence.
Even advanced SIEM and SOAR platforms can miss emerging threats if they lack fresh indicators. Integrating real-time intelligence into existing workflows can help teams:
- Detect threats earlier: Identify malicious activity using recently discovered IOCs.
- Reduce operational costs: Automate indicator collection and minimize manual detection-rule maintenance.
- Maximize existing investments: Improve detection coverage without purchasing additional security products.
For example, ANY.RUN's Threat Intelligence Feeds deliver malicious IPs, domains, and URLs through STIX/TAXII, APIs, and supported SIEM/SOAR integrations.
| TI Feeds provides actionable IOCs into existing security stack | 
According to ANY.RUN's internal research, up to 30% of unique malicious IOCs found in studied Sandbox analyses were already available in its TI Feeds, providing an opportunity to detect related threats earlier.
The budget priority: Strengthen intelligence coverage within your existing infrastructure before allocating funds to additional security products.
5. Prioritize Investments That Reduce the Financial Impact of Cyberattacks
Cutting SOC expenses means little if slower detection increases the risk of costly incidents. For 2027, investments should be evaluated against their ability to prevent attacks from escalating into serious breaches.
According to IBM's 2026 Cost of a Data Breach Report, the average financial-sector data breach costs $6.3 million.
Based on industry breach-cost research, ANY.RUN's internal risk model estimates potential avoided losses starting at $60,000 per qualifying phishing or malware incident in financial organizations through earlier detection and containment.
While this is a modeled estimate rather than guaranteed savings, it highlights why preventing incident escalation matters when allocating security budgets.
The budget priority: Assess investments based on their ability to improve detection, shorten response times, and reduce potential financial exposure.
Make Every SOC Investment Count in 2027
A stronger SOC doesn't necessarily require a larger budget. The real opportunity lies in making smarter investment decisions that improve security while keeping operational costs under control.
These five priorities can help organizations:
- Reduce operational costs by eliminating repetitive investigations and unnecessary manual work.
- Increase SOC capacity without proportional increases in staffing.
- Get more value from existing security investments through connected threat intelligence and stronger detection.
- Reduce financial exposure by improving threat detection and response before attacks escalate.
For 2027, the goal is clear: invest where improvements can be measured, eliminate unnecessary expenses, and build a SOC that delivers stronger protection with greater efficiency.

Cut SOC costs and cyber risks with your existing resources

articles.title: Typing 365 Turns PC Building, Technology and More into Typing Practice
articles.text:
Wednesday, November 25th 2026
Typing 365 Turns PC Building, Technology and More into Typing Practice
Typing faster is useful, but what if practice could also teach you something? Typing 365 is a free native Windows app that combines structured typing lessons, educational content, and competitive challenges.
With over 100,000 installs and nearly 4 million typing races completed worldwide, Typing 365 has grown into more than a speed test. Its Albums Store offers themed collections covering technology, science, history, psychology, and more.Build Your PC: A Free Album for First-Time Builders
The new Build Your PC album features 40 free typing exercises about desktop hardware. It covers motherboards, component compatibility, assembly, first boot, operating system installation, and troubleshooting.
Here's the idea in practice: instead of just reading a guide, you type passages such as "Before buying a CPU, check that its socket matches your motherboard and that the board's BIOS supports it." By the end of the album, you've practiced thousands of keystrokes while picking up the fundamentals of building a PC.
You might already know your way around a PC case, but it's an easy recommendation for students, first-time builders, or that friend whose build you always end up helping with.
Why a Native Windows App?
Browser-based typing sites are great for a quick test. Typing 365 is designed for consistent practice, combining a dedicated Windows experience with structured courses, progress tracking, and detailed performance statistics.
Beginners can start with Typing 101, a free course that gradually introduces keys before moving on to complete sentences. Other courses cover keyboard rows, punctuation, and speed development.
During practice, an on-screen keyboard and optional hand guidance support finger placement. The app tracks words per minute (WPM), characters per minute (CPM), accuracy, and mistakes. You can also turn your own notes or technical material into typing exercises.Find Your Weak Spots with PRO Analytics
The free app offers plenty of practice material, while Typing 365 PRO adds detailed analytics for users who want to improve their skills. View speed trends, session history, and keyboard heatmaps, or identify slow words, characters, and letter pairs for targeted practice.
PRO also unlocks exclusive albums, advanced courses such as Typing 102, which focuses on building typing speed, plus additional fonts, keyboard sounds, avatars, and customization options.
PRO is available through a monthly subscription or a one-time lifetime purchase, with US pricing starting at $2.99/month or $29.99 lifetime. Prices may vary by region.
Race Against Other Typists
Prefer competition? Join ranked typing races, compare your results with other players, and climb the global leaderboards. Whether you're chasing a personal best or a higher rank, every race offers a new challenge.
Practice in Five Languages
Typing 365 supports English, German, Spanish, Russian, and Arabic, allowing users to practice across languages and keyboard layouts.
From learning keyboard basics to understanding how a PC comes together, Typing 365 turns everyday practice into something worth your time.
Download Typing 365 for free from the Microsoft Store and start typing.
Typing 365 is available for Windows PCs, with optional premium albums and PRO features.

What is NYT Connections?
NYT Connections is one of several increasingly popular word games made by the New York Times. It challenges you to find groups of four items that share something in common, and each group has a different difficulty level: green is easy, yellow a little harder, blue often quite tough and purple usually very difficult.
On the plus side, you don't technically need to solve the final one, as you'll be able to answer that one by a process of elimination. What's more, you can make up to four mistakes, which gives you a little bit of breathing room.
It's a little more involved than something like Wordle, however, and there are plenty of opportunities for the game to trip you up with tricks. For instance, watch out for homophones and other word games that could disguise the answers.
It's playable for free via the NYT Games site on desktop or mobile.

articles.title: Canal+ ne se lance plus sur certains iPad, le groupe confirme le bug et donne la solution
articles.text:
L'application Canal+ ne se lance plus sur certains iPad sous iOS 17.7.1 depuis sa mise à jour 6.3.1. Le groupe a reconnu le bug lundi et recommande une manipulation précise pour retrouver l'accès aux programmes.
Les abonnés Canal+ qui regardent leurs programmes sur un iPad sous iOS 17.7.1 ont peut-être cru que leur tablette avait un souci. Car depuis la mise à jour 6.3.1, l'application ne se lance tout simplement plus. Le groupe a dissipé le doute en début de semaine en reconnaissant un incident technique sur son site d'assistance. Il ne dit pas d'où vient le bug, mais il a déjà trouvé la parade, au prix, vous allez le voir, d'un modeste sacrifice.
L'application Canal+ ne démarre plus sur certains iPad
Lundi 23 novembre, Canal+ a pris la plume sur l'espace consacré aux incidents de son application. La chaîne cryptée a décrit un bug qui semble venir d'un mauvais mariage entre deux versions, celle de l'application Canal+, passée en 6.3.1 lors d'une récente mise à jour, et celle du système qui fait tourner l'iPad, resté sous iOS 17.7.1.
Chez une partie des abonnés qui cumulent les deux, l'application refuse tout simplement de s'ouvrir. Combien sont-ils ? Mystère, puisque Canal+ évoque seulement « certains utilisateurs », et l'iPad reste le seul appareil cité.
Petite précision technique au passage, Canal+ parle d'iOS, mais sur iPad, le système d'Apple s'appelle iPadOS. Sa version 17.7.1 date d'octobre 2024, et Apple a depuis sorti plusieurs nouvelles versions, d'iPadOS 18 jusqu'à iPadOS 27 cette année. Les iPad touchés tournent donc sur un système qui n'est plus tout jeune. De son côté, Canal+ a mobilisé ses équipes tout en présentant ses excuses aux abonnés privés de leur application.
Pour réparer Canal+ sur iPad, il faut tout réinstaller
La solution, Canal+ a fini par la donner. En fait, il faut supprimer l'application Canal+ de l'iPad, puis retourner sur l'App Store pour installer la version 6.4.0, la plus récente. Le seul bémol reste qu'Apple prévient que supprimer une app peut effacer les données qu'elle contient. Les programmes téléchargés pour un visionnage hors connexion risquent donc de disparaître et devront être téléchargés de nouveau. Si le blocage persiste, Canal+ invite à signaler tout problème avec son application à l'adresse supportmobile@canal-plus.com, indiquée sur sa fiche App Store.
L'automne aura été agité chez Canal+. Début octobre, son patron Maxime Saada estimait à 200 millions d'euros le choc d'une TVA sur la télévision payante, qui passerait de 10 à 20 %. Il menaçait alors d'augmenter les abonnements d'environ 10 %, mais pas avant 2028-2029. En septembre, le tribunal judiciaire de Paris avait par ailleurs refusé d'imposer à Cloudflare une astreinte pouvant atteindre 1,55 million d'euros par jour, réclamée par Canal+ contre le piratage de la F1 et du MotoGP.

articles.title: Les Anneaux de pouvoir : la série aura-t-elle une saison 4 ? Prime Video a tranché
articles.text:
Les Anneaux de pouvoir : la série aura-t-elle une saison 4 ? Prime Video a tranché
La série dérivée du Seigneur des anneaux vient de conclure sa troisième saison sur Prime Video et la plateforme de streaming d'Amazon a déjà pris une décision concernant son avenir.
Alors que Sauron a enfin forgé l'Anneau unique dans la saison 3 de la série Le Seigneur des anneaux : les anneaux de pouvoir, reste maintenant à voir s'il va pouvoir s'en servir. Mais que les fans de cette fiction inspirée des écrits de J.R.R. Tolkien se rassurent : Prime Video a décidé de reconduire la série pour une saison 4.
Une nouvelle saison en préparation
Amazon n'a pas l'intention de quitter la Terre du Milieu de si tôt et a annoncé qu'une quatrième saison des Anneaux de pouvoir est déjà en pré-production. Son tournage commencera au printemps au Royaume-Uni pour de nouveaux épisodes qui sortiront sur Prime Video, on l'espère, d'ici à 2028.
Pour rappel, les showrunners de la série, J.D. Payne et Patrick McKay, ont depuis longtemps affirmé qu'ils ont un plan sur cinq saisons pour cette série dérivée du Seigneur des anneaux, alors il n'est pas surprenant qu'Amazon souhaite poursuivre l'aventure, même si les audiences de la série ont baissé depuis ses débuts.
Tonight’s finale is only a beginning. The Lord of the Rings: The Rings of Power will return for Season 4. pic.twitter.com/Ads6Ngcmaq
— The Rings of Power (@TheRingsofPower) November 24, 2026
“Le Seigneur des anneaux : les anneaux de pouvoir est devenu une série emblématique pour Prime Video”, a déclaré Peter Friedlander, responsable de la télévision mondiale chez Amazon MGM Studios.
“Alors que la troisième saison nous livre un moment clé attendu par les fans — la fabrication de l’Anneau unique —, nous sommes fiers de confirmer une quatrième saison, aux côtés de J.D. Payne, Patrick McKay et de toute l’équipe créative. Nous sommes impatients d’immerger davantage les fans dans le riche univers du Second Âge de Tolkien.”
La saison 3 de la série a en effet montré Sauron forger l'Anneau destiné à gouverner la Terre du Milieu, un moment jusque-là jamais porté à l'écran, lors d'une saison consacrée à la guerre entre les elfes et les forces du Mordor, cinq ans après les événements de la saison 2.
En attendant de savoir quelle direction prendra la saison 4, les trois saisons des Anneaux de pouvoir sont à retrouver en streaming sur Prime Video.

articles.title: Uber avisó a casi 150.000 conductores que hackers robaron datos de sus licencias de conducir
articles.text:
Uber notificó a 149.346 personas que sus datos personales, incluidas imágenes de sus licencias de conducir, fueron robados en un ataque informático a uno de sus proveedores tecnológicos. Según TechCrunch, la empresa es Fireworks AI, que da acceso a modelos de inteligencia artificial de código abierto.
La cifra figura en un aviso que Uber presentó ante el Departamento de Justicia de Oregón. La empresa no precisó cuántos conductores recibieron el aviso, y no está claro si el número aumentará.
Los datos comprometidos son imágenes de licencias de conducir y el texto extraído de ellas: nombre, dirección, fecha de nacimiento y número de licencia, según el aviso de Uber ante la Fiscalía General de Iowa, fechado el 10 de noviembre.
Cómo ocurrió el ataque
Según ese documento, el 9 de octubre un proveedor avisó a Uber de que un tercero no autorizado había comprometido sus credenciales internas y las había usado para entrar a la cuenta de la empresa en el servicio. Uber cortó de inmediato las conexiones de datos e inició una investigación.
El 13 de octubre, la investigación determinó que el atacante había usado esas credenciales el 7 de octubre para acceder a datos de Uber. La información estaba en un entorno de almacenamiento en la nube que la empresa creó para el trabajo del proveedor.
Uber tenía alertas activas, pero no se disparó ninguna: el atacante usó credenciales válidas y flujos de datos habilitados por el compromiso del proveedor. Las credenciales robadas no dieron acceso a otros sistemas de Uber, y la investigación sigue abierta.
Los avisos estatales dieron las primeras pistas del alcance. Uber informó unas 1.873 personas afectadas en Rhode Island y unas 2.999 en Iowa. Gizmodo y PCMag citaron además 3.430 en Carolina del Sur y 2.567 en Massachusetts, a partir de registros de esos estados.
Fireworks y otras empresas afectadas
Fireworks había informado de una filtración en octubre. Según Gizmodo, la empresa reconoció que los atacantes accedieron a datos de cuentas y de facturación, y a conjuntos de datos y modelos incompletos de un número limitado de cuentas. También dijo que entraron a sus equipos de desarrollo mediante otro incidente en un proveedor de nube.
Un portavoz de Fireworks confirmó a TechCrunch el acceso no autorizado a algunos sistemas, pero no respondió a las preguntas sobre el caso. La empresa atribuyó el ataque a un grupo cibercriminal con fines económicos, que busca vender credenciales para usar modelos de IA. Ningún grupo reivindicó el robo. Según el medio, Notion y Cursor confirmaron que también les robaron datos.
Uber ofrece a los afectados monitoreo de crédito y asistencia contra fraudes sin costo, a través de Cyberscout, una empresa de TransUnion. Los destinatarios tienen 90 días desde la fecha de la carta para inscribirse. El aviso recomienda revisar con regularidad los estados de cuenta y los informes de crédito, y considerar una alerta de fraude o un bloqueo de crédito. La empresa dijo que no identificó un uso indebido de los datos hasta ahora, y la investigación sigue en curso.
Reestructuración en Uber
Uber anunció el despido de alrededor de 3.300 empleados, el 10% de su plantilla global, en el marco de una reestructuración destinada a reducir niveles jerárquicos y reforzar las inversiones en transporte compartido, reparto y robotaxis.
Según explicó el CEO Dara Khosrowshahi en un correo enviado a los trabajadores, la medida busca eliminar la complejidad acumulada por el crecimiento de la compañía: se reducirá un 20% la cantidad de empleados ubicados a siete o más niveles jerárquicos del CEO y se eliminarán casi la mitad de los “microequipos” de una o dos personas.

articles.title: Microsoft Fixes Azure API Management Classic Flaw as Actor Targets Customer Secrets
articles.text:
Norway's National Security Authority (NSM) has disclosed that it became aware of a security vulnerability in Microsoft's Azure API Management (APIM) that has affected multiple businesses in the country, including energy companies Equinor and Skagerak Energi.
"An unknown actor has been actively looking for access tokens, secrets, and named values in APIM," NSM said. "It is still uncertain how extensive the exploitation of the vulnerability is, and has been."
The security agency said it has so far seen no evidence that has had any impact on Norwegian businesses.
According to a non-public advisory issued by Microsoft, the issue is said to affect the APIM classic tier. Instances on v2 tiers are not affected.
"On 18 November 2026, Microsoft identified a security issue affecting Azure API Management Classic tiers that could allow unauthorized access to certain management functionality if the service was not configured according to documented security best practices," Microsoft said in the advisory.
"Microsoft closed the access path on 19 November 2026. Our investigation found that customers were exposed and an unauthorized party could have used the issue to access secrets stored in Azure API Management Classic instances before Microsoft identified the security issue."
As a result, credentials or configuration secrets associated with the API Management resources may have been accessed by an unauthorized third-party if the service has not been configured as per security best practices. The information that may have been accessed could include -
- Secrets stored in Named Values Client secrets associated with identity providers
- Client secrets associated with OpenID Connect providers
- Subscription keys
- Tokens used to call direct management APIs
As of November 21, 2026, the Windows maker has released guidance for customers to help identify and rotate the secrets and credentials configured in their Azure API Management instances. It did not disclose how many customers were affected.
"If someone obtains a credential from that configuration, they may be able to use it directly against the service it protects," security researcher Anders Kristiansen said. "What they can reach depends on the credential's permissions and whether it is still valid."
NSM has also warned that the vulnerability affects several sectors in Norway and other entities outside of the country, adding it's working with national and international partners and businesses about the matter.

articles.title: Legendary Cooler Master Hyper 212 Halo CPU air cooler drops to an all-time low of $15 — keep your AMD or Intel processor running cool on the cheap
articles.text:
Legendary Cooler Master Hyper 212 Halo CPU air cooler drops to an all-time low of $15 — keep your AMD or Intel processor running cool on the cheap
Some case fans are more expensive than this cooler.
A variant of Cooler Master's legendary Hyper 212 series of CPU air coolers is on sale at an all-time low price. The Hyper 212 Halo is only $15 and is a great way to inexpensively cool your processor. It's currently 29% off and one of the least-expensive name-brand single-tower air coolers available right now.
All-time low price
Cooler Master's Hyper 212 Halo CPU air cooler is typically pretty cheap, but it's now on sale for Black Friday, making it one of the most affordable CPU coolers available. It boasts a single RGB-illuminated MF120 Halo 2 120mm ARGB fan and can cool most chips on the market (including Ryzen 9 chips) with its quad direct-contact heat pipe architecture.
The Hyper 212 Halo was released in 2023 in black, and the white version we're covering here. It uses the same single-tower design and is a compact 154mm tall, fitting in just about any non-SFF chassis. As always, check your case specifications to be sure.
The cooler works through four heatpipes that start with direct contact with the CPU IHS on the bottom and meander their way up through the fin array. The Halo comes with a single MF120 Halo 2 120mm fan that produces 51.88 cfm of airflow at a low 27 dB (according to Cooler Master), with the design allowing full RAM clearance.
The CPU cooler market hasn't been kind to Cooler Master, with companies such as Thermalright, and some overseas knockoffs redefining what budget CPU coolers should be priced at. This is one reason why Cooler Master air coolers are not on our list of the Best CPU Coolers for 2026 (although we do have three Thermalright air coolers on our list).
But, at just under $15, the Hyper 212 Halo (White) is a very compelling option in the cramped air cooling CPU market. The discount undercuts, albeit barely today, those like the Thermalright Assassin X 120R SE V2, which is currently our favorite air cooler under $20.
We haven't tested this specific version of the Hyper 212 Halo against the Assassin X 120R SE V2, but at just $15, it's a bargain regardless of how it compares to its Thermalright competition. Chances are, you are not looking to pair an $15 cooler with your Ryzen 9 9950X3D, so its cooling performance should be more than enough for any budget CPU you will likely be pairing with it. Better still, the Hyper 212 Halo comes in a fully blacked-out or whited-out aesthetic, so it can fit in with almost any build theme.

articles.title: Maxsun Launches MS-Terminator Z890-C WIFI Motherboard
articles.text:
Tuesday, November 24th 2026
Maxsun Launches MS-Terminator Z890-C WIFI Motherboard
Maxsun has introduced the MS-Terminator Z890-C WIFI, an ATX motherboard for Intel LGA1851 processors. The board measures 305 x 245 mm, has a 10+1+1 phase power delivery system, and an eight-layer PCB. The four DDR5 DIMM slots support up to 256 GB of memory with up to 8,800 MT/s (OC). Expansion options include one PCIe 5.0 x16 slot with support for x8/x8 or x8/x4/x4 lane bifurcation. Three additional PCIe 4.0 slots provide x4, x1, and x1 connectivity via its Intel Z890 chipset. For storage, the board offers four M.2 slots. One supports PCIe 5.0 x4 while the other three use PCIe 4.0 x4 interfaces. The board also has four SATA 6 Gbps ports and an SFF-8654 4i connector. The latter supports either PCIe 4.0 x4 or four additional SATA connections to connect U.2 and U.3 NVMe SSDs.
Networking is handled by a Realtek RTL8125D 2.5 GbE controller and a MediaTek MT7902 wireless module with Wi-Fi 6 and Bluetooth 5.2. Audio comes from a Realtek ALC897 codec. The rear I/O panel includes one HDMI 2.1, one DisplayPort 1.4, eight USB-A 5 Gbps ports, an RJ45 Ethernet port, two Wi-Fi antenna connectors, and audio jacks. According to IT Home, the Maxsun MS-Terminator Z890-C WIFI is available in China for CNY 1,249, or approximately $187. The motherboard also appears on the company's global website, but international pricing and availability have not been announced.
Sources:
				Maxsun (China), 				Maxsun (Global), 				IT Home

Those pictures are throwing me; the back make sit look like the third PCIe slot (slot5) is the primary x16, while the top slot has no wiring. I'm sure the first is x16, and the third is x4, but it just looks funny in that back picture.
HDMI 2.1, but only DP 1.4? I keep seeing this on motherboards and even monitors. This is weird; DP 2.0 and 2.1 are readily available. Maybe it's because DP 1.4 is cheaper to implement, while HDMI Forum only permits the newest standard? I didn't search this.
I also noticed two of the eight USB-A ports are 2.0, despite being color-coded for 3.0.
So, no Windows support then... :roll:
How do they dream up these names...
Looks reasonable - plus points for the x16 slots even if only wired x4 or x1, and the SFF allowing user to go for SATA or extra PCIe lanes.
Minus points for only being WiFi 6 standard - WiFi 7 even if only dual band would be better for a new product.
Maxsun/Soyo boards usually seem competent but anyone have any ideas about reliability? (Not that we'll likely see this outside of the eastern hemisphere)Probably because the DisplayPort 2.x PHY chips and other signalling bits probably impact the final BOM a lot more - DP 1.4 was in a better state of affairs vs HDMI 1.x.
Whilst the IGP may support DP2.x and 8K resolutions, maybe shooting for the moon isn't worth it vs just getting a dGPU.

articles.title: Chefe do Instagram reafirma que app não “escuta” o que você diz
articles.text:
Chefe do Instagram reafirma que app não “escuta” o que você diz
Adam Mosseri fala mais uma vez sobre o tema e garante que aplicativo não usa microfone do celular para direcionar anúncios aos usuários.
O chefe do instagram, Adam Mosseri, falou mais uma vez sobre uma suspeita antiga de usuários do Instagram: o app da Meta usaria o microfone do celular para ouvir o que está sendo falado e direcionar anúncios. O executivo voltou a se pronunciar sobre o assunto nesta terça-feira (24/11) na própria rede social, repetindo o discurso que trouxe em outubro de 2025.
Basicamente, ele nega qualquer tipo de “escuta” pelo app no smartphone. Os argumentos utilizados são os mesmos do ano passado. Segundo ele, essa seria uma grande violação de privacidade por parte do app. Além disso, a bateria acabaria rapidamente, da mesma forma que uma luz vermelha acenderia indicando uma gravação em curso. Dessa vez, em vez de “talvez você veja algo logo depois de falar”, Mosseri reconhece que isso acontece, mas explica que isso é mais psicológico do que tech.
Ou seja: o fato de você identificar anúncios logo depois de falar teria a ver com a sua atenção ao que está na tela, e não ao conteúdo em si. A Meta sempre negou essa teoria, sugerindo que já tem tantas informações sobre os usuários que não faria sentido coletar dados a partir de gravações do tipo.
Em outubro de 2025, um vídeo bem parecido foi publicado pelo executivo. Os argumentos também são idênticos, assim como a “culpada” pelo tema ser levado a público: sua esposa, com quem Mosseri teria discussões anuais sobre. No primeiro vídeo, a legenda chama de Myth Busting, ou uma caça ao mito, em português. Dessa vez ele foi mais sucinto, mas ainda trouxe o mesmo conteúdo.
De acordo com Mosseri, são três os principais motivos para você ter a sensação de que um anúncio apareceu logo após ter falado sobre um assunto:
- Você pode ter visto esse anúncio algumas vezes antes, o que teria levado a falar sobre o tema (antes de vê-lo novamente).
- Depois de ter falado sobre, o assunto fica na sua cabeça. Ao ver o anúncio novamente, fica com a sensação de ter sido direcionado.
- Você pode ter comentado o assunto com algum amigo próximo, cujos dados são, de fato, analisados pelo instagram. Com isso, o anúncio também poderia ser interessante para você, aparecendo na sua conta.
Por esses motivos, o chefe do Instagram reconhece a situação: você comenda sobre um assunto e, logo depois, o anúncio aparece. Mas ele reforça que isso não teria absolutamente nada a ver com gravações de áudio ou vídeo.
Dessa vez, além de argumentar contra a teoria do microfone, Mosseri afirma ter noção de que não vai convencer todos os usuários de que o Instagram não grava suas conversas. Ao reconhecer que a sugestão de produtos e serviços passa, sim, essa sensação, o executivo destaca o uso de outras formas de captação de informações dos usuários.
A própria Meta fala sobre o tema desde 2016, garantindo que não há necessidade de coletar dados dessa maneira. Em um artigo sobre a teoria ainda no Facebook, a empresa destacou que o uso do microfone é exclusivo de áreas em que há algum tipo de permissão por parte do usuário, como gravações de vídeo, por exemplo.

articles.title: Quand le patron d'ASUS voit les PC d'entrée de gamme passer de 16 à 8 Go de RAM
articles.text:
Un commentaire qui ne surprendra personne, mais qui confirme le bouleversement à l'œuvre sur le marché du PC avec l'inflation sur la RAM.
ASUS – comme tant d'autres – ne peut faire grimper indéfiniment les prix et mise donc logiquement sur la baisse des caractéristiques techniques des PC, en particulier sur l'entrée de gamme. Re-bonjour les configurations à base de, seulement, 8 Go de mémoire vive.
BenQ iScreenBar : la barre lumineuse qui s’accorde avec l’iMac
Des lignes en harmonie avec celles de l’ordinateur d’Apple, une conception rigoureuse, des matériaux sélectionnés, rien n’a été laissé au hasard, tout comme le service qu’elle rend une fois allumée !
Explosion du prix de la DRAM
Depuis maintenant plus d'un an, nous vous parlons de l'augmentation du prix de la DRAM en général et des barrettes de DDR5 en particulier. Une inflation qui ne semble pas devoir se démentir à l'approche de la nouvelle année.
Au contraire même, alors que l'on ne parlait d'abord « que » de hausses de l'ordre de 50 à 100 %, il a très vite fallu revoir ces chiffres. Aujourd'hui, il est davantage question d'un triplement, voire d'un quadruplement du prix des kits de mémoire vive (+400 % !). Forcément, cela a un impact sur les configurations vendues par les principaux fabricants à travers le monde.
Dans un premier temps, les constructeurs ont plutôt eu tendance à simplement suivre le marché et à augmenter le prix des machines proposées. Cependant, très vite, il est apparu que des PC avec 32 Go de mémoire vive à plus de 2 000 euros n'étaient guère populaires et on a commencé à voir – même sur du milieu de gamme – des configurations à 16 Go.
Reste que l'équation est encore plus complexe pour l'entrée de gamme. Là, le poids de la mémoire vive dans le prix global de la configuration devient très important et la moindre augmentation se ressent immédiatement. À Clubic, nous l'avons très bien vu sur les configurations des mini-PC passés entre nos mains avec des constructeurs qui tentent diverses solutions.
Nous avons vu des machines passer à de la DDR4, voire dans certains cas à de la DDR3. Nous avons aussi pu remarquer une transition très rapide des 16 Go vers les 12 Go et ce n'est clairement pas terminé.
Des PC d'entrée de gamme à 8 Go de RAM
À l'occasion de la publication des résultats financiers du groupe, le patron d'ASUS a effectivement évoqué la situation de la mémoire vive et l'impossibilité de garder des configurations d'entrée/milieu de gamme à 16 Go.
Tout au long de l'année 2026, ASUS a plutôt misé sur l'augmentation du prix de ses configurations que sur la réduction des caractéristiques techniques. Mais à en croire S. Y. Hsu, nous avons atteint une sorte de plafond et il semble difficile, aux yeux d'ASUS, de pousser encore plus haut des tarifs qui entraînent déjà une très nette baisse des ventes.
« Ils pourraient passer à 8 Go en raison de l'augmentation du coût de la mémoire ». Une petite phrase, toute simple, qui en dit long sur la difficulté de l'équation que doivent résoudre les fabricants de PC. De telles machines d'entrée de gamme à 16 Go ne seraient plus économiquement tenables pour les groupes comme ASUS.
S. Y. Hsu précise avoir déjà travaillé avec Microsoft sur la question de la mémoire vive. Jusqu'à présent, on conseillait toujours d'avoir au moins 16 Go de mémoire vive pour profiter d'une expérience Windows de qualité. Mais, comme par hasard, on a pu récemment voir Microsoft insister sur son travail d'optimisation afin de rendre les PC 8 Go plus confortables.
Cela dit, une réduction de la quantité de mémoire vive sur les machines les plus modestes ne fera pas de miracles et ASUS s'attend à ce que le marché du PC se contracte de 10 à 15 % au cours du premier semestre 2027, poursuivant une baisse déjà observée tout au long de l'année 2026. Les signes d'un léger rétablissement pourraient toutefois apparaître au second semestre.
Source : VideoCardz

articles.title: WHMCS SQL Injection Could Expose Customer Data and Admin Password Hashes without Login
articles.text:
A flaw in WHMCS's shopping cart, the billing and automation platform many web hosting companies use to run their businesses, could allow anyone on the internet to retrieve customer records and administrator password hashes from an installation's database. No login is needed.
The company disclosed the SQL injection yesterday along with two other flaws that need a logged-in client, and released fixed versions. It has not reported attacks using any of the three.
Because no login is needed, the flaw, tracked as CVE-2026-82981 (CVSS score: 8.7), is within reach of anyone who can load the shopping cart of a vulnerable installation over the internet.
The records an attacker could pull include clients' personal and support information as well as admin accounts with their hashed passwords, according to the company's advisory. A stolen hash is not a working password, but it gives attackers something to try to crack offline.
The 9.0.10 and 8.13.8 updates shipped yesterday, and the release notes list them as maintenance releases. For the 9.1 series, the security advisory names 9.1.2 as the fix, but that build had not yet appeared on the company's 9.1 release notes page at publication time.
Fixes are available only for supported versions, so installations on the 8.0 to 8.12 series must upgrade to a fixed release.
Installing the updates falls to self-hosted administrators, since WHMCS Cloud installations are updated automatically, according to the company's updating documentation.
The second SQL injection, CVE-2026-82979 (CVSS score: 7.1), sits in the Client Area and needs a logged-in client that holds the View & Manage Contacts permission. That client could read other customers' personal, billing, and support information, as well as the same admin records and password hashes, the second advisory says.
The third flaw, CVE-2026-93700, lies in how email campaigns process client-supplied data. A logged-in client could use it to read sensitive configuration files on the server, including database credentials, and to run code on the server, its advisory says.
It carries the highest score of the three, 9.0, though its CVE record uses the older CVSS 3.1 scale while the other two use CVSS 4.0. That record's vector indicates that some user interaction is required, and the company has not said what else exploitation entails.
All three flaws were reported by a single researcher who uses the handle alakazamspooon.
For the email-campaign flaw, updating is not the whole job. The email-campaign advisory also tells administrators to:
- Delete every planned or ongoing campaign under Utilities > Email Campaigns, using Delete in each campaign's Manage Campaign menu.
- Clear the template cache under Utilities > System > System Cleanup, using Empty Template Cache.
- Update to a fixed release.
The advisory does not explain why existing campaigns must go, leaving open the question of whether updating alone is enough.
This is at least the third round of WHMCS security fixes this year. The company patched an authorization flaw in the Client Area on May 12, described in its May advisory, and an unauthenticated remote code execution flaw on September 3, described in its September advisory.

articles.title: Black Friday – Les Apple AirPods Pro 3 tombent à 188 €, un prix plancher historique
articles.text:
Black Friday – Les Apple AirPods Pro 3 tombent à 188 €, un prix plancher historique
À 188 €, les AirPods Pro 3 passent sous la barre des 190 € pour la première fois. Réduction de bruit parmi les meilleures du marché, son immersif et fonctionnalités sportives : les écouteurs premium d’Apple n’ont jamais été aussi accessibles.
À seulement 188 €, les AirPods Pro 3 signent une offre particulièrement intéressante pour ce Black Friday. Proposés habituellement entre 200 et 210 € en promotion, les écouteurs premium d’Apple passent pour la première fois sous la barre des 190 €. Une occasion à saisir pour s’offrir les meilleurs écouteurs de la marque à leur prix le plus bas jamais constaté, avec une réduction de bruit parmi les plus performantes du marché et une qualité sonore de haut vol.
Apple AirPods Pro 3
AirPods Pro 3 : les meilleurs écouteurs Apple à leur prix le plus bas
Avec les AirPods Pro 3, Apple ne s'est pas contenté d'une simple mise à jour. Cette troisième génération adopte une véritable conception intra-auriculaire, avec de nouveaux embouts hybrides en silicone et en mousse qui renforcent l'isolation passive et améliorent le maintien. Un changement qui s’avère bénéfique pour les sportifs, d'autant que les écouteurs bénéficient désormais d'une certification IP57 contre l'eau et la transpiration, ainsi que d'un capteur cardiaque intégré.
Toutefois, leur principal argument reste incontestablement la réduction de bruit active. Grâce à leur nouvelle architecture acoustique et à leurs embouts plus isolants, les AirPods Pro 3 franchissent un cap impressionnant. Ils atténuent notamment jusqu'à 10 dB supplémentaires dans le haut-médium et les aigus par rapport à la génération précédente. Les conversations environnantes deviennent difficilement intelligibles et les bruits graves du quotidien, comme les moteurs ou les transports, sont particulièrement bien filtrés. Ils dépassent ainsi les Bose QuietComfort Ultra Earbuds (2e génération) et rivalisent avec les Sony WF-1000XM6, s'imposant parmi les toutes meilleures références du marché.
La qualité sonore est également au rendez-vous, avec une restitution précise, détaillée et immersive. Les basses gagnent en profondeur sans déborder sur les médiums, tandis que la scène sonore profite d'une belle ampleur. Leur signature sonore, plus démonstrative que celle des AirPods Pro 2, plaira à ceux qui apprécient un léger surplus de brillance. Autre bonne surprise, l'autonomie atteint désormais 8 h 40 min avec la réduction de bruit activée sur une seule charge.
À 188 €, les AirPods Pro 3 représentent donc une excellente affaire pour ce Black Friday. Avec leur réduction de bruit de référence, leur son immersif et leurs fonctionnalités sportives, ils n'ont jamais été aussi intéressants à ce prix.

articles.title: Cientos de videos falsos de Jensen Huang hechos con IA circulan en redes tras el escándalo de Nvidia
articles.text:
Cientos de videos falsos creados con inteligencia artificial muestran a Jensen Huang, el cofundador de Nvidia, bailando en una discoteca, cantando o apareciendo en escenas de películas. Circulan en Instagram, X y otras redes desde que se conocieron sus infidelidades, y varios suman millones de visualizaciones, según The Verge.
Uno de los más vistos, con casi 6 millones de reproducciones en Instagram, lo muestra en una fiesta en Ibiza con su chaqueta de cuero negra. Es una versión de un meme existente, en el que un obrero británico baila de la misma forma. En la copia, Huang aparece junto a Alice Huang, la ejecutiva china sospechosa de espionaje con quien tuvo una relación.
Entre los otros clips virales figuran una escena de la serie The Office y el video musical de “Careless Whisper”, de George Michael. Otro recrea el momento en que la cámara de besos de un concierto de Coldplay captó el año pasado al entonces director ejecutivo de Astronomer con una empleada. El rapero 50 Cent publicó una edición de su video “P.I.M.P.” con la cara de Huang.
Newsweek informó que el ingeniero belga Peter Dedene creó la versión de Coldplay con una herramienta de inteligencia artificial de código abierto mientras leía noticias sobre Nvidia desde la cama, y que el clip sumó millones de vistas, según The New York Times, citado por esa revista.
Herramientas chinas y chips de Nvidia
El creador de los videos de Ibiza, que se identificó ante The Verge como un hombre de 40 años de Melbourne, Australia, y no dio su nombre, dijo que gastó “miles” de dólares en generación de video. Usa modelos como Seedance 2.5, de ByteDance (la empresa china dueña de TikTok), y Wan 3, de Alibaba. Su cuenta acumula cerca de 100 millones de vistas con distintas versiones del meme, y la agencia AFP señaló que muchos clips se generaron en segundos con esa herramienta.
Varios modelos de video funcionan sobre procesadores de Nvidia, algo que un usuario resumió en un comentario citado por The Verge: sin la empresa, estos memes no serían posibles.
Meta, dueña de Instagram, permite estas ediciones siempre que los creadores avisen de que fueron hechas con IA, aunque AFP indicó que muchos clips circulan sin etiqueta. La compañía no respondió a la consulta del medio.
No todo es humor: audios e imágenes falsas con fines políticos
AFP y France 24 documentaron contenido que no era una broma. Cuentas prochinas difundieron un audio atribuido a Lori Huang, esposa del ejecutivo, en el que supuestamente defiende a Alice Huang, y una imagen que vincula a Huang con el Partido Comunista Chino. La organización NewsGuard, que vigila la desinformación, concluyó que el audio era falso, con un 99% de probabilidad de haber sido generado con IA, según France 24. La imagen también es falsa.
Joshua Tucker, codirector del Centro de Redes Sociales, IA y Política de la Universidad de Nueva York, dijo a AFP que la generación de imágenes y video con IA se usará tanto para engañar como para llamar la atención.
Zohaib Ahmed, director de la firma de detección Resemble AI, afirmó que las parodias de Huang son fáciles de reconocer, pero que el riesgo mayor persiste. Voces clonadas de directivos que piden transferencias y candidatos laborales con la cara cambiada siguen estafando a empresas, advirtió.
Hany Farid, profesor de la Universidad de California en Berkeley, dijo a Newsweek que hoy cualquiera con una descripción escrita puede crear videos sofisticados. A su juicio, estos clips son relativamente inofensivos, pero erosionan la confianza en el contenido visual: cuando aparezca un video real de Huang, será más fácil que él afirme que es falso.
El lunes 23 de noviembre, el directorio de Nvidia anunció que Huang volvió como presidente, director ejecutivo y miembro del directorio, tras “una serie de conversaciones y reuniones” y “aportes de altos niveles del gobierno de Estados Unidos”. Desde entonces, según The Verge, aparecieron memes que lo muestran victorioso.

articles.title: 3D printer tool changers are cheaper than ever, now starting at just $599 with multiple models at lowest-ever pricing — these game-changing multi-material, multi-color, filament-saving printers are all on sale
articles.text:
3D printer tool changers are cheaper than ever, now starting at just $599 with multiple models at lowest-ever pricing — these game-changing multi-material, multi-color, filament-saving printers are all on sale
Say hello to a new 3D printer and goodbye to wasteful filament “poop.”
Tool changers — 3D printers with multiple heads — have been a major focus of the industry for more than a year, and for good reason. Multiple heads mean you don’t have to purge the nozzle every time your print swaps colors or materials, which has the dual benefit of making complex prints much faster while saving a massive amount of filament waste or “poop,” which is a problem with more traditional multi-color AMS, single-toolhead printers.
But while these tool changers typically cost multiple thousands of dollars a few years ago, they’ve gotten much more affordable in the past year, starting with Snapmaker’s sub-$1,000 U1 (now just $699) and then Fashforge’s Creator 5 not long after. And both of those printers, plus a traditional four-color AMS printer designed to minimize wasted filament, are all on sale at their lowest-ever prices as we head into Black Friday.
So if you’re thinking of diving into the 3D printing realm or your existing printer is getting long in the tooth, now is a great time to make the leap to a tool changer and see how it can change your printing game — or perhaps your printing business.
Snapmaker’s U1 kicked off the affordable tool changer craze around this time last year, with an early Kickstarter price of $799 and a full retail price of $999. But now it’s widely available and on sale for $100 less than ever. When we reviewed the U1, we praised its roomy build area (270 mm cubed), direct-drive tool heads, and its four-head tool-changing capabilities, earning it 4.5 stars and a spot on our best 3D printers list.
Last year, this tool-changer was the most anticipated upcoming printer around. With four heads for swapping colors or materials without the need to "poop," it can breeze through complex multicolor prints much faster than single-head printers, without wasting nearly as much filament.
On the heels of the U1, Flashforge released the Creator 5, a tool changer that’s a bit more basic, but still a solid machine (we gave it 4 stars in our review), priced even lower than the Snapmaker, both when it launched (at $699) and now, when it’s on sale for $100 less. You can grab that base model, or the Creator 5 Pro, which adds an enclosure with a cooling fan and filtration for more consistent temperatures, which can prevent warping and generally lead to better prints.
This open CoreXY 3D printer has four toolheads, is rated for head swaps that take 7 seconds, and sports a 256 mm X3 build volume.
An upgraded version of the Creator 5, you get the same 4 tool heads and build volume, now with an enclosed chamber with a fan and filter. If you're sensitive to PLA or PETG fumes, your workspace lacks ventilation (or is drafty), or you print with more exotic filaments, it's worth paying extra for.
Last up, and least expensive on this list, is Anycubic’s Kobra X. This isn’t a tool changer, as it has a single head. Instead, it’s a more traditional four-color printer that aims to reduce filament waste by putting the filament cutter much closer to the nozzle tip. It also takes up less space, as it's designed to keep four filament spools on a rack up top rather than a separate AMD.
I’ve owned this printer for going on a year, and you’ll still see a lot of filament waste when tackling multi-color prints, but it does create less poop than previous printers I’ve owned. And if you can’t afford to spend more than $500, the Kobra X delivers solid multi-color printing at a price that’s tough to beat. It’s currently on sale for its lowest-ever price of just $279.
This low-priced, space-saving four-color 3D printer has a 260 mm X3 build volume, houses four filament spools up top, and is quick when swapping filaments. It also saves filament waste by cutting closer to the nozzle tip when switching, but it will still "poop," and can waste a lot of filament if you regularly tackle multi-color prints.

articles.title: Logitech and Razer mechanical keyboards under $100 I’d buy for work
articles.text:
I found two Logitech and Razer mechanical keyboards under $100 in the Black Friday sale that make typing at work way more satisfying
Office-friendly wireless keyboards for more comfortable typing and customizing your workflow
I've long sworn by mechanical keyboards for work - what can I say, I like the clack and the thunk as I hit at the keys while drafting articles and writing emails. So, of course it was one of the first things I searched for when the Black Friday sales went live.
Two in particular caught my eye. First up, the Logitech Alto Keys K98M wireless mechanical keyboard is down to $91 (was $120) at Amazon. The gasket-mounted design for softer, quieter typing, hot-swappable linear switches, a compact 98-key layout with a number pad, and Bluetooth plus Logi Bolt wireless.
Second, the Razer BlackWidow V4 X wired mechanical keyboard is $80 (was $130) at Amazon, which has six dedicated macro keys, a multi-function roller with media keys, and per-key Chroma RGB lighting.
A wireless mechanical keyboard with Logitech's UniCushion gasket mount, hot-swappable Marble linear switches, durable keycaps, and white backlighting. The compact 98-key layout keeps a number pad while taking up less space than a full-size board. It connects over Bluetooth or the Logi Bolt receiver, and you can program the action keys in Logi Options+.
A full-size wired mechanical keyboard with Razer Yellow linear switches, which actuate at 1.2mm with 45g of force. It has six dedicated macro keys, a multi-function roller and media keys, per-key Chroma RGB lighting, and double-shot ABS keycaps. A foam layer and lubricated stabilizers help reduce noise.
Why we recommend them
We haven't reviewed the Alto Keys K98M yet, but it's Logitech's first hot-swappable keyboard aimed at office workers rather than gamers. The gasket mount absorbs vibration, so typing sounds softer and feels smoother than on a typical mechanical board, and hot-swappable switches let you change the feel later without soldering. One catch: it's wireless only, so you can't use it over a cable.
The V4 X shares the same design, quiet performance, and dedicated macro keys of the Razer BlackWidow V4 Pro we reviewed. The V4 X keeps the parts most users care about - the switches, macro keys, and lighting- and skips the wrist rest and premium extras to hit a lower price.
Price Context & Historical Value
The Alto Keys K98M launched at $119.99, and this is about $30 off. It's a fairly new keyboard, so there isn't much price history yet, but $30 off is a solid discount for a Logitech mechanical board.
Razer lists the BlackWidow V4 X at $129.99, and Target still sells it for $119.99. At $79.99, you're saving $50, which is a strong price for a full-size Razer board with macro keys.
Should you buy them?
✅ Buy the Logitech Alto Keys K98M if... you type all day and want a mechanical keyboard that's quieter than most, you want a number pad without a full-size footprint, or you like the idea of swapping switches later.
✅ Buy the Razer BlackWidow V4 X if... your workflow will benefit from macro keys, you want fast linear switches, or you want a feature-packed Razer keyboard for under $100.
